# Tooltip
A small, non-interactive label that appears on hover or keyboard focus to name or briefly explain the element it points at. The arrow points back at the trigger.

USE WHEN
• Naming an icon-only button or control (e.g. "Add to library")
• Adding a short hint or keyboard shortcut to a control (one line, under ~10 words)
• Explaining an info icon (KPI card, chart legend) with one sentence

DON'T USE WHEN
• The content is essential to complete the task — put it inline or in helper text
• The content is interactive (links, buttons, forms) — use a Popover or Dropdown Menu
• The content is long or rich — use Dialog or inline copy
• On touch-only flows — hover/focus is not available; show the text inline

DO
• Keep text to one short line; sentence case, no trailing period
• Attach it to a focusable trigger so keyboard users reach it
• Let it flip automatically when it would leave the viewport

DON'T
• Put it on disabled controls without a focusable wrapper
• Repeat the trigger's visible label
• Stack multiple tooltips or nest them

PROPERTIES
• Side: bottom | top | start | end — the side of the trigger the tooltip appears on (arrow sits on the opposite edge, pointing at the trigger). start/end are logical and flip in RTL.
• Text: string — the tooltip content

TOKENS
• Fill: foreground; text: background (inverts in dark mode)
• Padding: spacing/3 horizontal, spacing/1_5 vertical; radius/md; arrow radius/sm
• Text: font-size/xs, regular, line-height/snug
• Layer: z-tooltip (code only)

CODE
import { TooltipProvider, Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from '@atlas/ui-web';

<TooltipProvider>
  <Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger asChild><Button variant="outline">Save</Button></TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent side="top">Add to library</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</TooltipProvider>
